title: Amazon.nl: ordinary voluntary return within 30 days
facts_text: I received wireless headphones from Amazon.nl 20 days ago. The item is unused, complete, not defective, not damaged, and not customised. It is within the 30-day voluntary returns window and I would like to return it for a refund.
request: Please accept my return and refund EUR 89.99 to my original payment method.
